info.title: ApiMark Tool
info.description: CLI tool that generates API documentation from source assemblies and headers.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help message

options.name: --silent
options.description: Suppress console output

options.name: --validate
options.description: Run self-validation tests

options.name: --results
options.description: Write validation results to file (.trx or .xml)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Set the top-level heading depth for generated Markdown output (default: 1)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: gradual (default) or single-file

options.name: --log
options.description:
Write all output to log file
Languages:
dotnet    Generate API documentation from a .NET assembly
cpp       Generate API documentation from C++ headers
vhdl      Generate API documentation from VHDL source files

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the .NET assembly (required)

options.name: --xml-doc
options.description: Path to the XML documentation file (required)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for Markdown files (required)

options.name: --visibility
options.description: Visibility filter: Public, PublicAndProtected, All (default: Public)

options.name: --include-obsolete
options.description: Include obsolete members in generated output

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Exclude namespaces/types matching a wildcard pattern (repeatable)

options.name: --enforce-docs
options.description: Enforce XML doc <summary> coverage at a visibility tier: Public, PublicAndProtected, All (default: disabled)

options.name: --includes
options.description: Include directory for clang -I (repeatable, required)

options.name: --api-headers
options.description: Glob pattern for documented headers, supports ! exclusions (repeatable, ordered)

options.name: --library-name
options.description: Library name used as the top-level heading (default: output directory name)

options.name: --library-description
options.description: Optional description for the library api.md introduction

options.name: --defines
options.description: Comma-separated preprocessor definitions (e.g. MYLIB_API=,NDEBUG)

options.name: --cpp-standard
options.description: C++ language standard passed to Clang (default: c++17)

options.name: --clang-path
options.description: Path to clang executable (default: auto-discovered via PATH / xcrun / vswhere)

options.name: --source
options.description: VHDL source glob pattern (repeatable; prefix with ! to exclude)
